name: com.scandit.datacapture.idaamvabarcodeverification.internal.sdk.init.IdAamvaBarcodeVerificationLibraryLoaderContentProvider
description: Android starts this Scandit Data Capture AAMVA barcode verification provider with the app process. It prepares AAMVA barcode verification used to check data from US driver's-license barcodes before the app uses that feature.
disableEffect: Disabling it can prevent Scandit AAMVA barcode verification features from initializing when the app needs them.
